crew_rook.style_summary: Patient driver: medium-tight, rarely bluffs, releases weak hands early.

crew_velvet.style_summary: Polished trap player: selective openings, persuasive raises, well-timed bluffs.

crew_knuckles.style_summary: Direct pressure player: aggressive with any made hand and unwilling to be pushed off pairs.

crew_switch.style_summary: Fast adaptive player: middling range, frequent small probes, escapes expensive traps.

crew_mags.style_summary: Exacting and tight: protects strong ranges, almost never pays to chase, raises for value.

crew_bishop.style_summary: Formal counterpuncher: conservative before the draw, more forceful when the record is clear.

crew_lucky.style_summary: Joyfully loose: enters nearly every pot, bluffs often, and treats thin draws as invitations.

crew_rook: Rook cuts the deck. 'No hurry. That's how money gets ideas.'
'Road rules,' Rook says. 'Leave yourself an exit.'
crew_velvet: Velvet smiles at the pot. 'Friendly money still deserves manners.'
'Darling, if you must raise, at least make it graceful.'
crew_knuckles: Knuckles nudges the ante in. 'Cards first. Speeches lose.'
'You can fold without apologizing,' Knuckles says. 'Please do.'
crew_switch: Switch is already dealing. 'Window's open. Keep up.'
'Long think means bad news or bad acting,' Switch says.
crew_mags: Mags squares the deck. 'Five cards. One draw. No creative accounting.'
'The pot is correct,' Mags says. 'Try to keep it that way.'
crew_bishop: Bishop antes precisely. 'Let the record show optimism.'
'A call is an answer,' Bishop says. 'Not always a good one.'
crew_lucky: Lucky splashes in the ante. 'Tiny money, enormous biography.'
'I had a plan,' Lucky says. 'Then the cards got interesting.'
